evidenceLevels.label: structural
evidenceLevels.claim: files, schema, manifest or static validation passes
evidenceLevels.proof: hash, parser, schema or linter output

evidenceLevels.label: isolated-runtime
evidenceLevels.proof: command, exit code, output summary and read-back artifact

evidenceLevels.label: live-runtime
evidenceLevels.claim: current Open Design/Agent runtime executes the capability
evidenceLevels.proof: runtime ID/version, task ID, artifact hash, stage/provenance read-back

evidenceLevels.label: release
evidenceLevels.claim: reviewed exact tree is published with exact-SHA CI evidence
evidenceLevels.proof: commit, push/PR/release, workflow run and remote read-back

evidenceLevels.label: commercial
evidenceLevels.proof: acceptance record, production feedback or delivery sign-off

source-governance.note: source registry + governance rules structurally present; E3 pending

brief-routing.note: atoms/scenarios present; isolated run not yet evidenced

visual-quality.note: rubrics + scoring scripts verified; live Open Design run pending

style-master-method.note: master records exist; source verification and method cards pending (Phase 7)

domain-scenarios.note: scenarios/profiles present; first domain pack not yet closed (Phase 4)

production-handoff.note: preflight/handoff schemas verified; production adapters pending

release-evidence.note: exact-SHA CI for c2f5fbc/f160240 passed; E4 requires frozen-tree release

hardRules: Static files do not prove Open Design runtime availability.
Model or VLM self-score alone does not prove design quality.
Reference-only or license-unclear material cannot enter runtime prompts as absorbed content.
A previous successful CI run on another SHA is not release evidence for the current tree.
Commercially proven requires external acceptance, not an internal demo.
